sentence: This project uses a survey experiment to study how people see wildfire risk reduction and whether they favor prevention over suppression.
This project builds machine learning models that use physics to manage microelectronic chips while they run, aiming to improve efficiency and reliability.
This project studies random quantum Hamiltonians to find out when they are easy or hard for classical and quantum computers to solve.
This project builds decision-making algorithms that keep performing well over long periods when real conditions differ from the ones the system trained on.
This project builds a portable, low-cost sensor that detects harmful forever chemicals in water on site and in real time.
This project tries to make parts built from light in liquid resin more precise by controlling the stress that builds up inside them.
This project uses microwave measurements and a deep learning neural network to estimate X-ray scan data, with stroke as its example.
This project prints a smart material that changes shape over time to find out how neural stem cells grow and change in that setting.
This project studies how hydrated electrons break down highly persistent contaminants in drinking water and which steps are involved.
This project designs efficient algorithms for objects whose points move under distance constraints, with uses in crystals and materials.
This project builds a framework that predicts how much prey change their behavior when predators pose a risk and what that costs the prey.
This project studies how sodium channels shape the electrical signals of sensory neurons that sense where the body and limbs are as they develop.
This project studies how proteins change their structure as they move from liquid to gas during mass spectrometry.
This project uses computer simulations to study how plasma behaves in stars and in an experimental fusion device.
This project builds a learning method where a person watches a machine as it learns, steps in when it acts unsafely, and shows the correct action.
This project develops course content on artificial intelligence and cybersecurity tools, working together with local industry.
This project develops algorithms that watch data streams from power grids and quickly detect and identify sudden problems.
This project studies how corals, together with the algae and microbes living in them, adjust to changes in their environment.
